name: Stremio iOS (Unofficial AltStore Source)
subtitle: Freedom to stream — unofficial AltStore-compatible source for iOS / iPadOS.
description: An unofficial AltStore source for Stremio iOS / iPadOS, compatible with any signing app that consumes the standard AltStore source format (Feather, AltStore Classic, AltStore PAL, ESign, Scarlet, Sideloadly, and others). Stremio's official source at dl.strem.io/apple/altstore/source.json cannot be parsed by most signing apps because it uses Apple's encrypted App Store Connect marketplace manifest format; this source points to plain IPA artifacts publicly available on the dl.strem.io CDN. Includes two packages: Stremio PAL (full-featured, com.stremio.pal) and Stremio Lite (legacy, com.stremio.ios). For Apple TV (tvOS) add the separate source: stremio-tvos.json. This is an unofficial community port, not supported by Stremio.

apps.localizedDescription: Stremio — a modern media center for movies, series, live TV and web channels. Expand your content library with the add-on system. Requires iPhone and iPad, iOS 13.0+. NOTE: Some features such as Apple Login and Handoff do not work in the sideloaded version.

versions.localizedDescription:
feat: Added P2P/torrent downloads with improved persistence and restoration.
feat: Added download exporting and sharing with external apps.
feat: Added quick access to Downloads from the profile picker.
feat: Added live torrent statistics for peers, download speed, and completion.
feat: Added vertical swipe controls for brightness and volume.
feat: Added visual feedback for double-tap seeking.
feat: Added support for Gravatar profile pictures.
feat: Added Cinemeta configuration for eligible profiles.
feat: Added streaming server cache size and torrent performance settings.
feat: Added warnings when system configuration may limit download functionality.
fix: Fixed tap-to-open and pause actions in Download Live Activities on iOS 17.0 and 17.1.
fix: Continue Watching now starts playback directly at the saved position instead of seeking twice.
fix: Fixed automatic subtitle selection and ensured subtitles refresh correctly when switching episodes.
fix: Fixed a KSPlayer crash when leaving playback on iOS 15 and macOS 12.
fix: Fixed the bottom navigation bar remaining visible on iOS 17 and earlier.
fix: Fixed playback when opening videos from Downloads or deep links.
fix: Improved player startup and local streaming server reliability.
fix: Improved Picture in Picture compatibility on macOS 27.

With the release of iOS 27 and Xcode 27, support for macOS 11 and iOS 14 or earlier is no longer possible. iOS 15 and macOS 12 will become the minimum supported versions when support for iPhone Duo begins.

fix: refresh content correctly after selecting a profile
fix: prevent Discover crashes and resolve the “See All” loading race condition
fix: prevent downloads from becoming stuck in a frozen state
fix: resume interrupted downloads when selecting “Retry”

fix: warn when hardware decoding is unavailable and software decoding is used
fix: correct subtitle offset behavior
fix: detect external displays when the app initially launches
fix: hide video content from app-switcher snapshots
fix: make play and pause respond immediately when the controls are hidden

### About Live Activities

Download Live Activities require iOS 16.2 or later. Due to iOS background-execution restrictions, live progress reporting may pause around 30 seconds after the app enters the background. The download will continue, and the Live Activity will update when it completes or fails.

A future update is planned to support background torrent downloading on iOS 26 and later. On older iOS versions, opening a video in Picture in Picture can keep the app running while a download continues.

fix: titles not showing on board and search
